onboarding.connectDesc: Link your hospital to see appointments, lab results, and get personalized AI advice.
onboarding.ozzyIntro: Hi! I'm Ozzy. I'll help you stay healthy with daily tips and personalized advice. Ask me anything!

goals.noGoalsDesc: Set a goal to start tracking your progress

smartCards.criticalAlertDesc: A vital reading needs your attention. Please review.

smartCards.healthTipDesc: Walk at least 30 minutes daily. It can reduce heart disease risk by 35%.
smartCards.weeklySummaryDesc: Your weekly health summary is ready to review.
smartCards.goalProgressDesc: You're making progress on your goals. Keep it up!

care.findCareDesc: Browse care options, discover services, and connect a hospital before your next appointment.
care.workspaceDesc: Switch between connected hospitals, review appointments and prescriptions, and keep your current care context clear.

records.vaultDesc: Keep your patient-owned files, prescriptions, and uploaded reports in one secure vault.
records.globalDesc: View your record timeline, carry a visit pass, and keep essential medical context ready beyond a single hospital.

wellness.trendsDesc: Track sleep, activity, vitals, and daily totals so your lifestyle trends are visible before they become problems.
wellness.tipsDesc: Use bite-sized, non-clinical guidance to stay consistent between visits and understand what habits to improve next.
wellness.diaryDesc: Look back at food, mood, and daily routines to understand what has changed over time.
wellness.medsDesc: Keep everyday medication adherence visible and reduce missed doses with reminder-friendly tracking.
wellness.hubDesc: Use AI-supported plans, routines, breathing, challenges, and sensitive wellness tools.

family.title: Manage family access and support
family.description: Keep dependents, proxy access, and household health context together so family care is not buried inside your own records.

profile.dataDesc: Complete your personal health details so guidance, records, and care handoffs stay more accurate.
profile.privacyDesc: Manage sensitive access, trusted devices, and profile-level permissions.

phq9.q7: Trouble concentrating on things, such as reading the newspaper or watching television

gad7.q3: Worrying too much about different things
